interpretation: Keep default interval 0. Periodic 16384-token checkpoints pass the same exact full-model state/source gates and help a synthetic first interior branch, but their full AgentX hour is lower. This observed pair does not isolate the full causal effect: count-driven warmups differ, scoring starts are offset by 570.056214 seconds, and groups share fabric. The default peer stops inference before the final periodic phase; its holder is released before the periodic send window ends. The guarded default result confirms a final recipe rate; its difference from the earlier unguarded cache-on hour is not an additional algorithmic gain.
